description:
The MCP (Model Context Protocol) feature is a competitive differentiator for BenchBox,
enabling AI assistants like Claude Code to run benchmarks via natural language. However,
MCP is currently invisible on the landing page and buried in documentation navigation.

This TODO addresses promoting MCP to first-class visibility alongside CLI and Library
interfaces, including landing page hero updates, a dedicated section, and improved
documentation navigation.

Findings from docs-review:
- Landing page has ZERO MCP mentions (nav, hero, features, or sections)
- MCP docs exist and are complete (reference: 375 lines, guide: 186 lines)
- MCP buried in docs/guides/index.md line 68 under "Integration"
- MCP buried in docs/reference/index.md line 28 under "Integrations"
